blocks.text: SOP: RF battery swap and end-of-shift charge

This is the working cut for PCF-SOP-2024-141 on December 5, 2024. Lila Voss asked for a written bound after the current path (Totes are unofficial chargers) stopped being honest. I am Jeilen Jones, Order Picker, writing for Marcus Hale, Tasha Quinn, and Ben Crowe. Primary host cage.pinecrest.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on leave guns in totes 'for the next wave', then open questions. If you are on the floor next shift, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the steps.

Swap under 30 percent. End of shift, gun on the cage charger, serial on the board. Tote is not a charger. I am not restating a hallway yes. leave guns in totes 'for the next wave' is out because November 21: 11 dead guns in totes, 22-minute start delay. Board would have shown it. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: dead=11, delay=22, pct=30, guns=40, weeks=2, totes=11, board=1, start=06:12. Sibling tickets PCF-2402 and PCF-SOP-2024-041. I will not reopen leave guns in totes 'for the next wave' in a side thread because someone asked for a rate waiver. Tasha Quinn is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.
Decision for leadership

blocks.label: Decision
blocks.text: Swap under 30 percent. End of shift, gun on the cage charger, serial on the board. Tote is not a charger.

Background on cage.pinecrest.internal. Totes are unofficial chargers. That is the system Marcus Hale lives with, not a slide. I timed or pulled the leftover on rf.pinecrest.internal the week before this file. Miss counts, minutes, and weights in this file are from that pull, not a round number I liked. Ticket PCF-SOP-2024-141 names the pull. If those numbers moved after December 5, 2024, update this file in review, do not 'correct' them in a group chat.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Ben Crowe owns a leftover that is easy to skip: huddle.pinecrest.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (26): refuse on leave guns in totes 'for the next wave', lock is 30 percent swap, cage charge, board serial. I will not hide a process change inside a 'quick align' on PCF-2402.
A gun left in a tote overnight is how the morning starts with 11 dead units.

What a skeptical lead would try first on cage.pinecrest.internal: the path Lila Voss actually has, not an empty-tote photo. Metric I will argue is a clean confirm, not a vanity units-per-hour. If we cannot show that path on rf.pinecrest.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Jeilen Jones will not accept a hallway yes as that proof.
Constraints and the lock

blocks.label: Lock
blocks.text: 30 percent swap, cage charge, board serial Host cage.pinecrest.internal. Ticket PCF-2402. Acceptor Marcus Hale.

Open clock: 30 percent swap, cage charge, board serial. If that clock collides with a safety lock, the date moves and the scope does not. Marcus Hale hears the new date on PCF-SOP-2024-141. I will not book a change in the last 40 minutes of a lock because it is 'just a rate.' A rate change is a change. Host if we have to prove a count: cage.pinecrest.internal.
